statement.p: Find a parameterization for the curve shown in the figure below.
(Note: you need to enter answers in all three answer blanks to receive feedback.)

static.solution: (3,2) to (6,3). The position vector of (1,1) is 3\vec i + 2\vec j and the displacement vector from (3,2) to (6,3) is 3\vec i + \vec j, so the line has equation \vec r = 3 \vec i + 2\vec j + t(3\vec i + \vec j), or x = 3 + 3 t, \quad y = 2 + t. This passes (3,2) when t=0 and (6,3) when t=1, so a possible parameterization is \vec r = x(t)\vec i + y(t)\vec j = (3 + 3 t)\vec i + (2 + t)\vec j, \quad 0 \le t \le 1.
